entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit support, my name is Judy. How can I help you today?
Hi Judy. I'd like to start a return for the VeloBand Pulse I bought last month. It's just... not for me.
Oh, absolutely, no problem. I can get that started for you right away. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF886-01. The name on the account is Sarah Chen.
Thank you, Sarah. I see your account here. Let's see... yes, you're a VIP member, thank you for your loyalty! And according to our policy, you are well within the 90 days for a full refund.
Oh, great! I was a little worried I might have missed the window.
Not at all. I've just processed the request. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email we have on file for you now. Just print it out, stick it on the box, and drop it at any post office.
That was incredibly easy. Thank you.
It's my pleasure! And since you're one of our VIPs, I've gone ahead and added a $25 credit to your account as a thank you for trying out the new VeloBand. You can use it on your next purchase.
Wow, that's really generous. Thank you so much, Judy. I appreciate it.
You're very welcome, Sarah. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that was everything. You've been wonderful.
Great! Have a wonderful day, and thank you for choosing VeloFit.
